_comment: Spec for the curated service cost-optimization agent catalog. Each entry generates one CloudFormation template via generate.py. Fields: key (file/stack suffix), agent (asset name, cost-<key>), title (report title), skill (matching *-troubleshooting skill in aws-samples/sample-ai-agent-skills, attached only if you import it and enable USE_SKILLS), lookback (true adds a LookbackDays param used for CloudWatch utilization), goal, approach (bullet lines), levers (savings levers). All agents get read-only tools use_aws + query_cloudwatch_logs.

services.title: EKS Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find EKS cost waste — control-plane clusters with no or idle workloads, over-provisioned managed node groups, and Fargate profiles running underutilized pods.
approach: List clusters with `eks list-clusters` / `eks describe-cluster`; each running control plane bills hourly even when idle.

List node groups (`eks list-nodegroups`, `eks describe-nodegroup`) and read node CPU/memory utilization from CloudWatch Container Insights over the lookback window; flag consistently low-utilization groups.
List Fargate profiles (`eks list-fargate-profiles`) and correlate with pod activity where visible.
Prefer Compute Optimizer where it covers the underlying nodes (`compute-optimizer get-auto-scaling-group-recommendations`).
services.levers: idle control planes, over-provisioned node groups, Graviton/Spot candidates, oversized Fargate pods

services.title: ECS / Fargate Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find ECS/Fargate cost waste — services with over-provisioned task CPU/memory, idle services running desired-count above demand, and clusters with no running tasks.
approach: List clusters and services (`ecs list-clusters`, `ecs list-services`, `ecs describe-services`).
Read task CPU/memory utilization from CloudWatch (`CPUUtilization`, `MemoryUtilization`) over the lookback window; flag services far below their task-definition reservations.
Flag services with desired count sustained above observed need, and empty clusters.
Prefer Compute Optimizer ECS recommendations (`compute-optimizer get-ecs-service-recommendations`).
services.levers: oversized task sizing, idle services, Fargate Spot / Graviton candidates

services.title: Auto Scaling Group Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Auto Scaling groups that waste money — groups holding more capacity than demand requires, no dynamic scaling policy, or fixed high min capacity.
approach: List groups (`autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups`) and their policies (`autoscaling describe-policies`).
Read aggregate group CPU/utilization from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag groups with high min/desired but low utilization.
Flag groups with no target-tracking/step scaling that sit at a fixed high capacity.
Prefer Compute Optimizer ASG recommendations (`compute-optimizer get-auto-scaling-group-recommendations`).
services.levers: over-fixed min capacity, missing dynamic scaling, Spot mix, rightsizing

services.title: Elastic Beanstalk Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Elastic Beanstalk environments that are idle or over-provisioned — environments with no traffic, oversized instance types, or load-balanced single-instance workloads.
approach: List environments (`elasticbeanstalk describe-environments`) and resources (`elasticbeanstalk describe-environment-resources`).
Read underlying EC2/ELB utilization from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle or low-traffic environments.
Flag load-balanced environments serving negligible traffic that could be single-instance.
services.levers: idle environments, instance rightsizing, unnecessary load balancers

services.title: AWS Batch Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find AWS Batch waste — compute environments holding On-Demand capacity that could be Spot, high minvCpus keeping instances warm, and idle environments.
approach: List compute environments and queues (`batch describe-compute-environments`, `batch describe-job-queues`).
Flag EC2 compute environments with minvCpus above 0 (warm capacity) and On-Demand where Spot is viable.
Read job history / instance utilization from CloudWatch over the lookback window to spot idle environments.
services.levers: Spot vs On-Demand, minvCpus warm capacity, idle compute environments

services.title: Lightsail Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Lightsail waste — idle instances, unattached static IPs, unused load balancers, and idle managed databases.
approach: List instances, databases, load balancers, static IPs (`lightsail get-instances`, `get-relational-databases`, `get-load-balancers`, `get-static-ips`).
Read instance CPU/network metrics (`lightsail get-instance-metric-data`) over the lookback window; flag idle instances.
Flag static IPs not attached to a running instance and load balancers with no traffic.
services.levers: idle instances, detached static IPs, unused load balancers, idle databases

services.title: Aurora Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Aurora cost waste — idle clusters, over-provisioned instances, provisioned clusters that could be Serverless v2, and excess reader replicas.
approach: List clusters and instances (`rds describe-db-clusters`, `rds describe-db-instances`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization`, and ServerlessDatabaseCapacity from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle or low-utilization clusters.
Flag provisioned clusters with spiky/low usage as Serverless v2 candidates, and readers carrying little query load.
services.levers: idle clusters, instance rightsizing, Serverless v2 candidates, excess readers

services.title: RDS MySQL Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find RDS MySQL cost waste — idle instances, over-provisioned instance classes and storage, unnecessary Multi-AZ on non-critical databases, and old manual snapshots.
approach: List instances (`rds describe-db-instances --filters Name=engine,Values=mysql`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization`, `FreeStorageSpace` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned databases.
Flag over-allocated storage and Multi-AZ on databases that may not need it.
List manual snapshots (`rds describe-db-snapshots --snapshot-type manual`) and flag old ones.
services.levers: idle instances, instance/storage rightsizing, Multi-AZ review, old snapshots

services.title: RDS PostgreSQL Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find RDS PostgreSQL cost waste — idle instances, over-provisioned instance classes and storage, unnecessary Multi-AZ, and old manual snapshots.
approach: List instances (`rds describe-db-instances --filters Name=engine,Values=postgres`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization`, `FreeStorageSpace` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned databases.
Flag over-allocated storage and Multi-AZ on databases that may not need it.
List manual snapshots (`rds describe-db-snapshots --snapshot-type manual`) and flag old ones.
services.levers: idle instances, instance/storage rightsizing, Multi-AZ review, old snapshots

services.title: RDS MariaDB Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find RDS MariaDB cost waste — idle instances, over-provisioned instance classes and storage, unnecessary Multi-AZ, and old manual snapshots.
approach: List instances (`rds describe-db-instances --filters Name=engine,Values=mariadb`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization`, `FreeStorageSpace` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned databases.
Flag over-allocated storage and Multi-AZ on databases that may not need it.
List manual snapshots (`rds describe-db-snapshots --snapshot-type manual`) and flag old ones.
services.levers: idle instances, instance/storage rightsizing, Multi-AZ review, old snapshots

services.title: RDS Oracle Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find RDS Oracle cost waste — idle instances, over-provisioned instance classes and storage, license-model review (LI vs BYOL), and old manual snapshots.
approach: List instances (`rds describe-db-instances --filters Name=engine,Values=oracle-ee,oracle-se2`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization`, `FreeStorageSpace` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned databases.
Note license model and flag over-allocated storage.
List manual snapshots (`rds describe-db-snapshots --snapshot-type manual`) and flag old ones.
services.levers: idle instances, instance/storage rightsizing, license model, old snapshots

services.title: RDS SQL Server Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find RDS SQL Server cost waste — idle instances, over-provisioned instance classes and storage, edition/license review, and old manual snapshots.
approach: List instances (`rds describe-db-instances --filters Name=engine,Values=sqlserver-ee,sqlserver-se,sqlserver-ex,sqlserver-web`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization`, `FreeStorageSpace` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned databases.
Note edition (a lower edition may suffice) and flag over-allocated storage.
List manual snapshots (`rds describe-db-snapshots --snapshot-type manual`) and flag old ones.
services.levers: idle instances, instance/storage rightsizing, edition review, old snapshots

services.title: DynamoDB Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find DynamoDB cost waste — provisioned tables far above consumed capacity with no autoscaling, tables that would be cheaper on-demand (or vice versa), unused global secondary indexes, and idle global tables.
approach: List and describe tables (`dynamodb list-tables`, `dynamodb describe-table`).
For PROVISIONED tables, compare provisioned vs consumed read/write capacity from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag large gaps and missing autoscaling.
Flag steady low-traffic tables that suit provisioned, and spiky/low tables that suit on-demand.
Flag GSIs with negligible consumed capacity and idle global-table replicas.
services.levers: capacity-mode fit, provisioned overshoot, missing autoscaling, unused GSIs

services.title: ElastiCache Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find ElastiCache waste — idle Redis/Memcached clusters, over-provisioned node types, and clusters with very low hit rates or memory usage.
approach: List clusters and replication groups (`elasticache describe-cache-clusters`, `elasticache describe-replication-groups`).
Read `CPUUtilization`, `DatabaseMemoryUsagePercentage`/`BytesUsedForCache`, `CurrConnections`, and cache hit metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window.
Flag idle clusters, oversized node types, and unnecessary replica counts.
services.levers: idle clusters, node rightsizing, excess replicas, Graviton candidates

services.title: MemoryDB Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find MemoryDB waste — idle clusters, over-provisioned node types, and excess shard/replica counts.
approach: List clusters (`memorydb describe-clusters`) and node metadata.
Read CPU, memory, and connection metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and oversized clusters.
Flag shard/replica counts higher than the workload needs.
services.levers: idle clusters, node rightsizing, excess shards/replicas

services.title: Redshift Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Redshift waste — idle provisioned clusters, clusters that could pause or move to Serverless, over-provisioned node counts, and unused Concurrency Scaling.
approach: List clusters (`redshift describe-clusters`) and Serverless workgroups (`redshift-serverless list-workgroups`).
Read `CPUUtilization`, `DatabaseConnections`, query activity from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle or low-utilization clusters.
Flag steady-idle provisioned clusters as pause/Serverless candidates and oversized node counts.
services.levers: idle clusters, pause/Serverless candidates, node rightsizing

services.title: DocumentDB Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find DocumentDB waste — idle clusters, over-provisioned instance sizes, and excess replica instances.
approach: List clusters and instances (`docdb describe-db-clusters`, `docdb describe-db-instances`).
Read `DatabaseConnections`, `CPUUtilization` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned clusters.
Flag replica instances carrying little read load.
services.levers: idle clusters, instance rightsizing, excess replicas

services.title: Neptune Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Neptune waste — idle clusters, over-provisioned instances, and Serverless capacity candidates.
approach: List clusters and instances (`neptune describe-db-clusters`, `neptune describe-db-instances`).
Read `CPUUtilization`, connection/request metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle and over-provisioned clusters.
Flag low/spiky-usage clusters as Serverless candidates.
services.levers: idle clusters, instance rightsizing, Serverless candidates

services.title: Keyspaces Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Keyspaces (Cassandra) waste — provisioned tables far above consumed capacity, and capacity-mode mismatches.
approach: List keyspaces and tables (`keyspaces list-keyspaces`, `keyspaces list-tables`, `keyspaces get-table`).
For provisioned tables compare provisioned vs consumed capacity from CloudWatch over the lookback window.
Flag capacity-mode mismatches (steady vs spiky) and missing autoscaling.
services.levers: capacity-mode fit, provisioned overshoot, missing autoscaling

services.title: Timestream Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Timestream waste — tables with long memory-store retention (expensive) that could move to magnetic sooner, and idle databases.
approach: List databases and tables (`timestream-write list-databases`, `list-tables`, `describe-table`).
Review memory-store vs magnetic-store retention; flag long memory retention that inflates cost.
Read ingestion/query metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window to spot idle tables.
services.levers: memory-store retention tuning, idle tables

services.title: EFS Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find EFS waste — file systems without lifecycle management to Infrequent Access, idle/unmounted file systems, and Provisioned Throughput that exceeds usage.
approach: List file systems (`efs describe-file-systems`) and lifecycle config (`efs describe-lifecycle-configuration`).
Flag file systems with no lifecycle policy to move cold data to IA/Archive.
Read `TotalIOBytes`, `ClientConnections` from CloudWatch to spot idle file systems.
Flag Provisioned throughput mode where Bursting/Elastic would be cheaper.
services.levers: missing IA lifecycle, idle file systems, throughput-mode fit

services.title: FSx Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find FSx waste — over-provisioned storage and throughput capacity, idle file systems, and deployment types richer than needed.
approach: List file systems (`fsx describe-file-systems`) across Lustre/Windows/ONTAP/OpenZFS.
Review provisioned storage and throughput capacity against usage metrics from CloudWatch.
Flag idle file systems and Multi-AZ where Single-AZ may suffice.
services.levers: storage/throughput rightsizing, idle file systems, deployment-type review

services.title: AWS Backup Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find AWS Backup waste — recovery points retained far beyond policy, orphaned recovery points from deleted resources, and cross-region copies that may be unnecessary.
approach: List backup vaults and recovery points (`backup list-backup-vaults`, `backup list-recovery-points-by-backup-vault`).
Flag recovery points far older than their backup plan retention and points whose source resource no longer exists.
Review cross-region/cross-account copy jobs for necessity.
services.levers: over-retention, orphaned recovery points, redundant copies

services.title: Storage Gateway Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Storage Gateway waste — idle gateways with no I/O and over-provisioned cache/upload buffer.
approach: List gateways and volumes (`storagegateway list-gateways`, `list-volumes`, `list-file-shares`).
Read I/O and cache-hit metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle gateways.
Flag oversized cache/upload buffer relative to usage.
services.levers: idle gateways, cache rightsizing

services.title: Global Accelerator Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Global Accelerator waste — accelerators with no healthy endpoints or negligible traffic still incurring the fixed hourly charge.
approach: List accelerators, listeners, endpoint groups (`globalaccelerator list-accelerators`, `list-listeners`, `list-endpoint-groups`).
Read traffic/flow metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag accelerators with near-zero traffic.
Flag accelerators with no healthy endpoints.
services.levers: idle accelerators, unused endpoint groups

services.title: Transit Gateway Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Transit Gateway waste — attachments with negligible traffic still billing hourly, and blackhole/unused attachments.
approach: List transit gateways and attachments (`ec2 describe-transit-gateways`, `describe-transit-gateway-attachments`).
Read per-attachment traffic from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag attachments with near-zero traffic.
Flag attachments to deleted/unused VPCs and blackhole routes.
services.levers: idle attachments, unused/blackhole attachments

services.title: VPC Endpoints / PrivateLink Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find VPC endpoint waste — interface endpoints with no traffic billing hourly per-AZ, and redundant endpoints across subnets/AZs.
approach: List endpoints (`ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints`).
Read per-endpoint traffic from CloudWatch (`VpcEndpoint` / PrivateLink metrics) over the lookback window; flag idle interface endpoints.
Flag duplicate endpoints for the same service and over-broad AZ coverage.
services.levers: idle interface endpoints, redundant AZ coverage

services.title: Direct Connect / VPN Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Direct Connect / VPN waste — VPN connections with tunnels down or no traffic still billing hourly, and idle DX virtual interfaces.
approach: List VPN connections (`ec2 describe-vpn-connections`) and DX connections/VIFs (`directconnect describe-connections`, `describe-virtual-interfaces`).
Read tunnel state and traffic from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle/down VPNs.
Flag DX virtual interfaces with negligible traffic.
services.levers: idle VPN connections, unused DX virtual interfaces

services.title: CloudFront Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find CloudFront waste — distributions with low cache-hit ratios (inflating origin transfer), disabled/unused distributions, and price-class mismatches.
approach: List distributions (`cloudfront list-distributions`).
Read `Requests`, `BytesDownloaded`, and cache-hit-rate metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window.
Flag low cache-hit distributions, enabled-but-idle distributions, and price classes broader than the audience needs.
services.levers: low cache-hit ratio, idle distributions, price-class fit

services.title: Route 53 Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Route 53 waste — health checks attached to nothing, and hosted zones for domains no longer in use.
approach: List hosted zones and health checks (`route53 list-hosted-zones`, `route53 list-health-checks`).
Flag health checks not referenced by any record set (each bills monthly).
Flag hosted zones with only default records (candidates for cleanup) — report as evidence, never assume safe to delete.
services.levers: orphaned health checks, unused hosted zones

services.title: EMR Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find EMR waste — long-running idle clusters, On-Demand core/task groups that could be Spot, and clusters without managed scaling.
approach: List clusters (`emr list-clusters --active`) and instance groups/fleets (`emr describe-cluster`, `list-instance-groups`).
Read YARN/CPU utilization from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle long-running clusters.
Flag On-Demand task groups that suit Spot and clusters without managed scaling.
services.levers: idle clusters, Spot for task nodes, managed scaling

services.title: Glue Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Glue waste — jobs over-allocated on DPUs/workers, jobs with excessive timeouts, and development endpoints left running.
approach: List jobs and dev endpoints (`glue list-jobs`, `glue get-job`, `glue get-dev-endpoints`).
Review worker type / number of workers vs job run metrics (`glue get-job-runs` DPUSeconds/executionTime).
Flag over-allocated jobs and any running development endpoints.
services.levers: DPU/worker rightsizing, running dev endpoints, autoscaling

services.title: Athena Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Athena waste — workgroups with no per-query data-scanned limit, and heavy full-scan query patterns that partitioning/compression would reduce.
approach: List workgroups (`athena list-work-groups`, `athena get-work-group`).
Flag workgroups without `BytesScannedCutoffPerQuery` limits or result-reuse enabled.
Review recent queries (`athena list-query-executions`, `get-query-execution` DataScannedInBytes) for high-scan patterns.
services.levers: per-query scan limits, result reuse, partitioning/compression guidance

services.title: Kinesis Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Kinesis waste — provisioned Data Streams with far more shards than throughput needs, idle streams, and enhanced fan-out consumers no longer used.
approach: List streams (`kinesis list-streams`, `describe-stream-summary`).
Read `IncomingBytes`/`IncomingRecords` vs shard count from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag over-sharded and idle streams.
Flag registered enhanced fan-out consumers with no activity; consider on-demand mode for spiky low volume.
services.levers: shard rightsizing, on-demand mode, unused fan-out consumers, idle streams

services.title: MSK Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find MSK waste — over-provisioned broker instance types and counts, over-allocated storage, and idle clusters.
approach: List clusters (`kafka list-clusters`, `describe-cluster`).
Read broker CPU, disk usage, and throughput from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag over-provisioned brokers and idle clusters.
Flag over-allocated broker storage; consider Serverless for spiky low volume.
services.levers: broker rightsizing, storage tuning, Serverless candidates, idle clusters

services.title: OpenSearch Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find OpenSearch waste — over-provisioned data/master node counts and types, no UltraWarm/cold tiering for old indices, and idle domains.
approach: List domains (`opensearch list-domain-names`, `describe-domain`).
Read CPU, JVM memory, search/index rate, and storage from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag over-provisioned and idle domains.
Flag hot-only storage for old indices that could use UltraWarm/cold; consider Serverless for spiky workloads.
services.levers: node rightsizing, UltraWarm/cold tiering, idle domains

services.title: MWAA (Airflow) Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find MWAA waste — environments sized larger than DAG load requires, high min-worker floors, and idle environments.
approach: List environments (`mwaa list-environments`, `get-environment`).
Read scheduler/worker CPU and task metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window.
Flag oversized environment class, high MinWorkers floors, and environments with negligible DAG activity.
services.levers: environment-class rightsizing, min-worker floor, idle environments

services.title: API Gateway Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find API Gateway waste — idle APIs still deployed, REST APIs with caching enabled but low hit value, and REST-vs-HTTP API cost mismatches.
approach: List REST and HTTP APIs (`apigateway get-rest-apis`, `apigatewayv2 get-apis`) and stages.
Read `Count`, `CacheHitCount`/`CacheMissCount` from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle APIs.
Flag REST stages with provisioned cache and low hit rates, and simple REST APIs that would be cheaper as HTTP APIs.
services.levers: idle APIs, cache review, REST-to-HTTP candidates

services.title: Step Functions Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Step Functions waste — high-volume Standard workflows that would be far cheaper as Express, and idle state machines.
approach: List state machines (`stepfunctions list-state-machines`, `describe-state-machine`) and their type.
Read execution counts from CloudWatch over the lookback window.
Flag high-volume short-duration Standard workflows as Express candidates, and state machines with no executions.
services.levers: Standard-to-Express candidates, idle state machines

services.title: SQS / SNS Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find SQS/SNS waste — empty/unused queues and topics still polled by consumers, and aggressive short-poll patterns driving request cost.
approach: List queues and topics (`sqs list-queues`, `sns list-topics`).
Read `NumberOfMessagesSent`/`NumberOfMessagesReceived` and SNS publish metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag unused queues/topics.
Flag queues with zero `ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds` (short polling) that inflate request counts.
services.levers: unused queues/topics, long-polling adoption

services.title: AppSync Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find AppSync waste — idle GraphQL APIs, over-provisioned server-side caches, and N+1 resolver patterns inflating request volume.
approach: List GraphQL APIs (`appsync list-graphql-apis`) and cache config (`appsync get-api-cache`).
Read request/latency metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; flag idle APIs.
Flag oversized cache instance types and resolver patterns that multiply requests.
services.levers: idle APIs, cache rightsizing, resolver efficiency

services.title: SageMaker Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find SageMaker waste — always-on real-time endpoints with low invocation volume, running notebook instances left idle, and over-provisioned instance types.
approach: List endpoints, notebook instances, and apps (`sagemaker list-endpoints`, `list-notebook-instances`, `describe-endpoint`).
Read `Invocations` and instance CPU/GPU utilization from CloudWatch over the lookback window.
Flag low-traffic endpoints (serverless/async candidates), idle running notebooks, and oversized instance types.
services.levers: idle endpoints, serverless/async candidates, idle notebooks, instance rightsizing

services.title: Bedrock Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find Bedrock waste — Provisioned Throughput model units running below utilization, and idle provisioned commitments.
approach: List provisioned model throughput (`bedrock list-provisioned-model-throughputs`, `get-provisioned-model-throughput`).
Read model invocation metrics from CloudWatch over the lookback window; compare against provisioned model units.
Flag provisioned throughput running well below capacity, and idle commitments that on-demand would serve cheaper.
services.levers: provisioned-throughput rightsizing, on-demand vs provisioned fit

services.title: CloudWatch Logs Cost Optimization
services.goal: Find CloudWatch cost waste — log groups with no retention (never expire), very high ingestion groups, and unused custom metrics/dashboards.
approach: List log groups (`logs describe-log-groups`) and their retention and stored bytes.
Flag log groups with retention never-expire and the highest stored-bytes / ingestion groups.
Flag high dashboard/custom-metric counts as review items.
services.levers: log retention policies, high-ingestion groups, unused metrics/dashboards
